What's in it:
- All 10 seconds, with her original voice unchanged.
- English captions made automatically from her speech. They are centred at the bottom of the frame, below her face.
- To keep them from pulling attention away from her, I used the plain "minimalist" style: white text with a thin black outline and no animated word highlighting.
- It cost 48 credits.

Why it isn't 9:16: Magic Hour has no tool that crops or reframes a video to a new shape. The only option would be the AI video editor, but it re-creates the footage. That could change how she looks and might not keep her original voice, so I didn't use it.

To get the vertical version, crop this captioned file to 9:16 around her in any basic editor (CapCut, iMovie, Premiere and so on). The captions are centred, so they should stay in the frame if the crop is centred on her. I haven't watched the result, so please check that the caption wording matches what she says.
